descriptor.scene: TWO PEOPLE MEETING is the subject. At frame RIGHT the ENGINEER stands slightly apart from the room, holding a closed laptop against his chest, shoulders a little guarded. DAVID KOBROSKY has just crossed to him, arriving at frame CENTER in warm three-quarter view, his signature gesture live: one open palm turned warmly upward at waist height, the other arm sweeping gently back toward the room, eyes locked on the engineer's eyes, mid-smile. The engineer's face is beginning to open. In the soft-focus background LEFT, GARY in his light-wash denim jacket with the yellow smiley patch on the left chest and the orange pixel-mascot patch on the right chest talks with someone at the whiteboard, small and out of focus but present. Ordinary room, warm lamp light. If David and the engineer do not read as meeting each other's eyes, the image is wrong.
descriptor._caption: David's job is older than software. He notices who is standing alone at the edge of the room, crosses it with his hand already out, and says the four words he was born to say. Let me introduce you.
